exposure: All old confirmation groups exposed. Only original development groups used for fitting/selection. No repeated old-test evaluation in this round.
hypothesis: A common strain-squared damage proxy may conceal a different strain dependence. Fit a strain exponent while holding the logarithmic cycle exposure fixed.
The preceding floor and load-feedback models did not improve the log baseline; their extra mechanisms were inactive or weakly identified.
E/E0=clip(1-k*(strain_percent/1)^p*log1p((N-20)_+/1000),0,1). This is conditional recorded stiffness, not fatigue life.
metric: Same whole-group primary metric as preceding continuation;67 equal configuration/particle absolute log error;60 train-condition-normalized MAE;71/73/82/83 RMSE, otherwise MAE.
selection: Compare candidate to every exact-cohort saved predecessor and new matched HGB. Gains under1% are practically inconclusive; lower error alone does not establish a mechanism.
validation: Predecessor whole-group or forward folds, preserved. Every fit excludes its validation groups except permitted causal within-group/history/context calibration. No targets used for added moisture or initial-map inputs.
continuation: One discriminating new cycle per case, followed by revisions only when actual development evidence supports a distinct test. Stop after two substantive no-gain revisions.
input_additions: No new measurements; deterministic transforms of existing allowed inputs.
baselines: Exact-cohort predecessor OOF predictions and fixed constrained HGB with same permitted information; no group IDs as new predictors.
admission: retrospective candidate only; no novel-law, causality, fresh validation or intervention-impact claim.
